## Closure recommendation (not owner-approved)

No additional external candidate currently justifies entering the bounded operational critical path. Complete #630/#633 and #634/#624, disposition #628/#631, freeze actual B/C outcomes, then revisit this matrix only where a material outcome changes. For every deferred/no-adoption item retain rationale and future trigger; record owner acceptance rather than silently checking off criteria. Existing source register includes maintainer documentation, academic research, practitioner reports and engineering case studies; full query/exclusion and version audit, independent final challenge and final internal freeze remain open. No claim of DOD-9 completion, cross-stack empirical validation, or final DOD-10 AFTER cohort.

Do not add synthetic PRs or duplicate expensive runs solely to complete the report. Ordinary contributor development may proceed under the currently qualified draft/local and exact-tree gates; final longitudinal observation is distinct from operational acceptance.
